infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FIRSTgo uses the camera to scan the customer's IDFC FIRST offer QR code, photograph RCs, and run the customer's face e-KYC (front camera liveness check).
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FIRSTgo needs access to your photos to upload the customer's RC.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FIRSTgo uses the microphone so you can talk to Zippy.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: FIRSTgo uses speech recognition so Zippy can show your words as you speak and act on voice commands.
